BL-621 — Front-desk degraded warnings carry the underlying error; sustained poll/relay outages escalate to the human
Approval context: One recommendation to veto cheaply: the sustained-outage escalation reuses the stuck-delivery direct Telegram send (works during a getUpdates 409) with a default 30-minute continuous-failure threshold, once per episode. If you would rather have email (like the supervisor's gave-up path) or a differ…
BL-621 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-621" (or "reject BL-621 <reason>") to act.
